stepByStepSolution: An online connection with the manufacture is required for Parameterization via the SVM (Software Version Management).
When found in Golf 5 and 6 based  14-Susp. Elect. (J250) control modules, see this forum thread.
technicalNotes: Parameterization refers to data written into the control unit by the SVM function (Software Version Management) to customize the software functionality for the specific vehicle or country of operation.
